name: Bull City Big Cubes NC 2026
information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BullCityBigCubesNC2026#62063-competitor-information) prior to registering**.
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BullCityBigCubesNC2026#70436-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
